correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power q and t≠0, an elementary character-sum bijection gives S=q−χ(−1), an affine-line restriction establishes the two-circle intersection bound, explicit centers 0 and a+b classify pair incidences, and excluding antipodal pairs characterizes every shattered triple. Unique-center counts yield s2=q²S²/4 and s3=q²S(S−2)(S−4)/6. The absence of four-point shattering follows from unique triple centers. All exceptional cases q=3,5 are handled. The embedded executable independently tested all centered triples and pair displacement traces in fifteen finite field/parameter instances; no unproved infinite extrapolation is used.
